text:
Hana: Hey folks 1st day here. Quick map question: who handles access for the Private appliance (SSH bastion, vault paths, node certs)? Also who do I loop in to request a Dedicated test allocation for an end-to-end perf run?

Ethan: welcome Hana! For Private appliance infra access it's split: eng-infra handles machine-level access (bastion, certs) and security-eng owns vault ACLs.

Ravi: hi Hana :wave: For node certs we use the cert-service managed by eng-infra; please include the node name + intended TTL when requesting. Example: `node: maya-test-01 ttl: 7d`.

Hana: awesome. Who triages requests that touch both vault and infra (like a cert that needs vault ACLs)?

Marta: put both `infra-triage` and `security-eng` on the ticket. We have a cross-team tag `private-onboard` for these. Include the deployment id and approver (manager).

Hana: and Dedicated test allocation? I need 4 concurrent slots for a short perf test. Who books that?

Ethan: eng-platform owns Dedicated capacity bookings. Use the bookings form (https://go/redwood/infra-bookings) and tag `onboard:perf`. If it's for an immediate smoke test, PM `@Marta` and we can do a fast-path approval within the hour.

ops-bot: PagerPolicy: private-appliance-alert -> #eng-oncall rotation (2m). If no ack -> #eng-sre-secondary (10m) -> #eng-infra-escalation (20m).

Hana: great. One more: in case a nightly sync to the private appliance fails and oncall doesn't respond, is there a fallback that retries automatically or switches to a backup?

Ravi: the pipeline has a retry window: 3 retries spaced 5m apart. If all fail, we mark the run as `failed` and kick a manual intervention ticket. The escalation path is oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-infra. If unacked after 30m ops-director gets a page.

Marta: ownership cheat:
- Bastion/SSH + node certs: eng-infra (Ravi)
- Vault paths & ACLs: security-eng
- Dedicated test allocations: eng-platform (Ethan)
- Cross-team tickets & fast-path approvals: ops (Marta)
- Oncall/escalation: eng-sre

Hana: super helpful. Is there a one-page "who to cc" for hybrid requests (vault+infra+platform)? New hires would love a template.

Ethan: yes, we keep a snippet in the onboarding repo. Quick template (paste into your ticket): `component: private-appliance area: cert+vault owner: eng-infra,security-eng contact: @eng-infra @security-eng tags: private-onboard urgency: low`

Hana: perfect, saving that. Thanks everyone! Tagging for my notes :heart:
